vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At reconstructed BIC 0714fc6ac6576e83a035ca2f4090dd7a97ee8e93, GET /api/invoices/{id} accepts an Invoice entity, checks only view_invoice, and serializes it without checking access on its customer. ROLE_TEAMLEAD receives the INVOICE permission set containing view_invoice, while CustomerVoter::access restricts customers by team membership unless the customer has no teams or the user can see all data. The collection endpoint separately calls InvoiceArchiveQuery::setCurrentUser(), so the single-entity endpoint bypasses that scoping. CVE-2026-28685 is currently PUBLISHED and describes this cross-team invoice disclosure; GHSA-v33r-r6h2-8wr7 has withdrawn_at null.

atomic_bic.evidence: PR #5070 member 0714fc6ac6576e83a035ca2f4090dd7a97ee8e93 is the smallest surviving public commit that first adds src/API/InvoiceController.php and the vulnerable getAction. Its parent is d6d48795fa28f8711434eac3f0080379c6550b20. The default-branch pickaxe first sees squash carrier 8de54e1fa7ffe3b911c93080f4abd0210bbc22b0, not a finer mainline commit.
